dex.text: A wee wave in a fine blue coat that cannot hear a line of verse without finishing it. It has been known to start one first. They do not scan, and it will not be told.
dex.fact: In Hebridean legend the Blue Men of the Minch (na fir ghorma) live in the strait between Lewis and the Shiant Isles. They swim up to boats and call out a line of verse: a skipper who can finish the rhyme sails on, and one who cannot is overturned.

dex.text: The chief of the Blue Men, grey-bearded in foam, rises out of a squall with a verse in one hand and a thunderbolt in the other. He is perfectly civil to anyone with a good ear for a rhyme, and to everyone else he is a wave.
dex.fact: The Minch, between the Outer Hebrides and the Scottish mainland, is notorious for its sudden storms. Sailors told of the Blue Men as the cause: their chief would raise a storm and challenge the crew to a rhyming contest.
